data.title: Leiter Finanzbuchhaltung (w/m/d) inkl. Controlling- & Homeoffice-Anteil
data.description:
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir Sie als

Teamleiter Finanzbuchhaltung (w/m/d) mit Interesse an weiteren Themen, u.a. aus dem Controlling und Aufgaben für die Geschäftsleitung,

für ein alteingesessenes und gesundes Unternehmen aus dem Automobilumfeld mit ca. 70 Mitarbeitenden und Sitz im Raum Ditzingen.

In Abhängigkeit von Ihren Erfahrungen und Kenntnissen können Sie hier bis zu 75.000 € p.a. verdienen.

Nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung haben Sie einen Homeoffice-Anteil von einem Tag pro Woche.

Die Vollzeitstelle ist im Rahmen der Personalvermittlung zu besetzen. Bedeutet also: Sie haben von Anfang an ein festes Anstellungsverhältnis mit Ihrem neuen Arbeitgeber, der Sie gerne viele Jahre beschäftigen möchte.

Der besseren Lesbarkeit wegen richten sich alle folgenden Bezeichnungen an alle Geschlechter.

Aufgaben

Voilà, so sieht Ihr neuer Job aus!

  • Sie arbeiten hands-on mit in Kreditoren-, Debitoren- und Anlagenbuchhaltung

  • Sie stimmen die Konten ab und erstellen die Monatsabschlüsse selbstständig

  • An den Jahresabschlüssen arbeiten Sie mit und trauen sich zu, diese auf Sicht selbstständig zu erstellen

  • Sie erstellen Umsatzsteuer- und ZM-Meldungen

  • Außerdem kümmern Sie sich um das Mahnwesen und den Zahlungsverkehr

  • Auch die Liquiditätsplanung liegt in Ihren Händen

  • Sie bringen sich ein bei der weiteren Prozessoptimierung im Bereich Buchhaltung

  • Ergänzend führen Sie eine Finanzbuchhalterin

  • Für die Geschäftsführung übernehmen Sie Sonderaufgaben

  • Dazu kann auf Sicht auch Ihre Mitwirkung beim weiteren Controlling-Aufbau kommen.

Qualifikation

Das bringen Sie mit:

  • Sie verfügen über mindestens drei Jahre in einer vergleichbaren oder ähnlichen Aufgabe

  • Bisherige Führungserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung

  • Sie verfügen über anwendersichere Datev-Kenntnisse

  • Sie kommunizieren mündlich und schriftlich in sehr gutem Deutsch

  • Wir verzichten gerne auf die an dieser Stelle üblichen persönlichen Attribute und möchten Sie als Person kennenlernen. Wichtig ist zunächst, dass Sie Lust auf nette Kollegen haben und ein absoluter Teamplayer sind, der sich fachlich gerne weiter entwickeln möchte.

  • Uns ist klar, dass kaum jemand alle Anforderungen erfüllen wird. Auch solche Bewerbungen sind herzlich willkommen!

In 3 einfachen Schritten zu Ihrer neuen Anstellung:

1.) Bewerbungsunterlagen als PDF abspeichern (Verzichten Sie gerne auf ein Anschreiben).

2.) Bewerbung absenden

3.) Wir setzen uns sehr zeitnah mit Ihnen in Verbindung.

Bei Fragen steht Ihnen unsere Personalberater Uli Davidsson unter der Rufnummer 0711 / 528 509 - 16 jederzeit gerne zur Verfügung.

Kann man uns vertrauen? Wir meinen JA!

Fischer & Partner ist zum besten Personalvermittler der DACH-Region (Deutschland, Österreich, Schweiz) ausgezeichnet worden. Weiterempfehlungsrate: glatte 100%. Weitere Informationen unter:

https://www.kununu.com/de/fischer-partner-gesellschaft-fuer-personal-mbh/bewerbung?sort=newest

Was Sie sonst noch über uns wissen sollten:

Falls diese Stelle nicht zu Ihnen passen sollte, bewerben Sie sich bitte trotzdem: Wir können Ihnen Stellen als Finanzbuchhalter und Bilanzbuchhalter in der Region Stuttgart immer wieder vorschlagen, ebenso als Entgeltabrechner und Controller.

Finden Sie weitere attraktive Stellenangebote auf unserer Homepage.

Für Sie als Bewerber arbeiten wir kostenfrei und mit höchster Diskretion. Bevor wir Sie bei potenziellen Arbeitgebern in anonymisierter Form vorschlagen, sprechen wir immer zuerst mit Ihnen über die jeweilige Stelle! Ohne Ihre Zustimmung unternehmen wir keinen Schritt. Ihre Daten sind bei uns sicher!

Unser Qualitätsversprechen: Wir beantworten jede Bewerbung sehr zuverlässig innerhalb von max. drei Werktagen, i.d.R. schneller. Wenn Sie also nach drei Werktagen nichts von uns gehört haben, kann es technische Gründe dafür geben. Bitte haken Sie in diesem Fall bei uns nach.

data.title: Sales Engineer - North UK
data.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Sales Engineer to strengthen our team in the Northern region of England, ideally based in Northern UK (Carlisle, Newcastle upon Tyne, Edinburgh, Glasgow and surrounding areas)

This is a dynamic, customer-facing role combining technical expertise and commercial acumen, focused on delivering liquid storage, pumping and filtration solutions across a wide range of industries.

Tasks

  • Maintain and develop relationships with new and existing customers

  • Promote solutions across industries such as water treatment, petrochemical production, refining, construction and environmental remediation

  • Analyse and communicate market trends, opportunities and risks to management, including actionable recommendations

  • Collaborate closely with operations and internal teams to exceed customer expectations

  • Provide inside sales support and actively support the promotion of safety-related products

  • Plan and execute marketing activities, including online campaigns, social media and editorial content

  • Prepare presentations, reports and internal communications

  • Support and participate in trade shows, exhibitions and industry conferences from planning through execution

  • Oversee the local depot, including material checks, quality assurance and status monitoring

  • Ensure compliance with statutory Health & Safety regulations

  • Maintain accurate records of incidents and operational activities

  • Support additional day-to-day business activities as required

Requirements

  • Degree or postgraduate qualification in Engineering, or a technical related field

  • Engineering background strongly preferred

  • Proven experience in the pump industry and/or industrial cleaning sector

  • Demonstrated track record in sales

  • Experience in customer support (B2B and B2C)

  • Strong market knowledge within relevant industries

  • Proficiency in MS Office applications

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills

  • Ability to build long-term customer relationships

  • Proactive and hands-on mindset

  • Open to new systems, tools and ideas

  • Strong time management and planning skills

  • Ability to work independently and accurately

  • Fluent in English, additional languages is a plus

Benefits

  • A challenging and varied role in a growing international environment

  • Opportunity to work with innovative technical solutions

  • High level of autonomy and responsibility

  • Competitive salary

  • Company car, mobile phone, laptop

If you are passionate about technical sales, have experience in the pump industry, and enjoy building strong customer relationships, we would love to hear from you.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (m/w/d)- E-Commerce & Shopify
data.description:
Du willst nicht einfach nur Code schreiben, sondern technische Verantwortung übernehmen und unsere E-Commerce-Plattform mitprägen? Sauberer Code, performante Shops und messbare Conversion-Erfolge sind für Dich Anspruch, kein Nebenschauplatz. Dann könntest Du schon bald unser neuer Senior Full Stack Developer (m/w/d) sein.

Über SHEKO

Als Online-Shop gestartet, sind wir heute eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Health & Nutrition Brands Deutschlands – mit Balance Shakes, Kollagen, Probiotika und Supplements, die in dm, Rossmann und Müller stehen. Inhabergeführt, profitabel, mit echtem Wachstum vor uns.

Aufgaben

  • Shopify-Entwicklung auf Senior-Niveau: Du entwickelst neue Shopify-Themes von Grund auf (Liquid), pflegst und erweiterst bestehende Themes, baust individuelle Funktionalitäten und Custom-Apps und nutzt die Shopify APIs (REST & GraphQL) für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen
  • Full-Stack-Features end-to-end: Vom Frontend (JavaScript/TypeScript, React) bis zum Backend (Node.js und/oder PHP, APIs, Integrationen) verantwortest Du Features von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live
  • Refactoring, Performance & Code-Qualität: Du refactorst und modernisierst bestehenden Code, sorgst für sauberen, wartbaren Code, schnelle Ladezeiten und eine stabile technische Basis – inklusive Code Reviews und Etablierung von Best Practices
  • Conversion-starke Landing Pages: Du baust und optimierst mobile-first Landing Pages und begleitest A/B-Tests von der Idee bis zur datenbasierten Auswertung
  • Technische Architektur mitgestalten: Du bringst Dich bei Tool-Auswahl, Schnittstellen und der Weiterentwicklung unserer E-Commerce-Infrastruktur ein und triffst fundierte technische Entscheidungen
  • Technische Pflege & Monitoring: Du verantwortest Updates, Performance-Monitoring und sorgst dafür, dass technisch alles zuverlässig läuft
  • Wissen teilen: Du unterstützt das Team fachlich, gibst Deine Erfahrung weiter und hebst unseren technischen Standard insgesamt an

Qualifikation

Für diese Rolle suchen wir gezielt eine erfahrene Entwicklerin oder einen erfahrenen Entwickler, die oder der eigenverantwortlich arbeitet und technische Verantwortung übernehmen möchte. Entscheidend ist für uns, was Du in der Praxis bewegen kannst.

Das solltest Du mitbringen:

  • +2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Shopify-Entwicklung (Liquid, Theme-Entwicklung, Shopify APIs) – idealerweise aktuell und durchgehend bis heute
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Full Stack Developer
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in JavaScript/TypeScript sowie in modernem Frontend (z. B. React)
  • Solide Backend-Kenntnisse (Node.js und/oder PHP), Erfahrung mit REST-/GraphQL-APIs und Integrationen von Drittsystemen
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in HTML & CSS sowie ein gutes Auge für UX und mobile Optimierung
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git und sauberen, nachvollziehbaren Entwicklungsprozessen
  • Eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen zu treffen und zu begründen
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse

Bonuspunkte für:

  • Erfahrung mit Conversion-Rate-Optimierung und A/B-Testing
  • Erfahrung mit Tools wie Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager oder Hotjar
  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD und Performance-Optimierung
  • Erfahrung mit weiteren E-Commerce- oder CMS-Systemen

Benefits

  • Echte Gestaltungsfreiheit: Flache Hierarchien, offene Feedback-Kultur und die Möglichkeit, ein wachsendes Unternehmen aktiv mitzuprägen
  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Wir entwickeln gemeinsam Karriereziele, die zu Dir passen – fachlich wie persönlich
  • Starkes Team: Hands-On-Mentalität, enormer Zusammenhalt und eine Kultur, in der gegenseitige Unterstützung selbstverständlich ist
  • Modernes Office: Wohlfühlfaktor in Hamburg-Winterhude, zentral am schönen Mühlenkamp in Alsternähe. Dresscode? Komm wie Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst
  • Die Basics: Wasser, Tee, Kaffee & Shake-Flat, regelmäßige Team-Events und legendäre Firmenpartys

Klingt nach Dir?

Dann bewirb Dich – mit Deinem Lebenslauf und gerne Links zu Projekten, an denen Du mitgebaut hast. Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

data.title: Embedded Software Entwickler (m/w/d)
data.description:
Du möchtest nicht nur Software entwickeln, sondern direkt erleben, wie dein Code reale Systeme steuert und weiterentwickelt?

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Unser Kunde entwickelt und fertigt autonome Drohnensysteme, Einsatzsoftware und spezialisierte Lösungen für Industrie, Netzbetreiber, Behörden und maritime Anwendungen. Dabei entstehen hochspezialisierte Systeme, die Hardware, Software und autonome Technologien miteinander verbinden und bereits bei namhaften Kunden zum Einsatz kommen.

Für die Weiterentwicklung der Drohnensysteme wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die Verantwortung für hardwarenahe Software übernimmt, bestehende Systeme weiterentwickelt und gemeinsam mit einem kleinen technischen Team neue Funktionen bis zum Flugtest bringt.

Deine Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Hohe Eigenverantwortung bei der Weiterentwicklung zentraler Softwarekomponenten und technischen Strukturen.

  • Entwicklungsperspektive: Perspektivisch besteht die Möglichkeit, fachliche Verantwortung für das Softwareteam zu übernehmen.

  • Technologieumfeld: Arbeit an innovativen Drohnensystemen, Embedded Software und autonomen Technologien mit direktem Bezug zur Hardware.

  • Praxisnähe: Kurze Wege von der Entwicklung zum Flugtest und die Möglichkeit, neue Funktionen direkt im realen System zu erproben.

  • Flexibilität: Nach der Einarbeitung ist Homeoffice nach Absprache möglich, wobei die regelmäßige Arbeit an Hardware eine Präsenz vor Ort erforderlich macht.

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Eigene Werkstatt und Testgelände sowie moderne Hard und Software für die Entwicklung und Erprobung.

  • Unternehmenskultur: Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und eine offene Du Kultur.

  • Teamspirit: Regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten und Teamevents sorgen für ein persönliches und unkompliziertes Miteinander.

  • Individuelle Benefits: Persönliche Wünsche und Vorschläge sind willkommen. Gemeinsam werden individuelle Benefits erarbeitet.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Embedded Software Entwickler übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung der Flugsteuerungs- und Bedienersoftware unserer Drohnensysteme.

  • Flight Control: Technische Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung der Flugsteuerungssoftware und deren zuverlässigen Betrieb auf der Zielhardware.

  • Bodenkontrollsoftware: Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Bedienersoftware auf Basis von Qt und QML für Missionsplanung, Drohnenüberwachung und Nutzlaststeuerung.

  • Codebasis: Einarbeitung in bestehende Softwarestrukturen, Dokumentation der Architektur sowie Aufbau sauberer Prozesse für Tests, Releases und Updates.

  • Hardwareintegration: Anbindung und Integration von Sensoren, Funkmodulen, Kameras, Ladesystemen und weiteren Nutzlasten.

  • Debugging: Analyse von Fluglogs, Auswertung technischer Daten und systematische Fehlersuche direkt auf der Zielhardware.

  • Flugerprobung: Begleitung und Durchführung von Flugtests sowie technische Unterstützung bei Erprobungen und gelegentlichen Kundeneinsätzen.

  • Technische Leitung: Fachliche Betreuung eines Auszubildenden und von Werkstudenten, Durchführung von Code Reviews und aktive Weitergabe von Wissen.

  • Architektur: Mitarbeit an technischen Architekturentscheidungen in enger Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit Hardwareentwicklung, Konstruktion und Werkstatt, um Software und Gesamtsystem gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, davon überwiegend im Embedded Bereich oder in der hardwarenahen C und C++ Entwicklung.

  • Sehr gute praktische Kenntnisse in modernem C++, Qt und QML. Sowie Linux und Git.

  • Erfahrung darin, sich selbstständig in umfangreiche bestehende Codebasen einzuarbeiten und komplexe Softwarestrukturen schnell zu verstehen.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im hardwarenahen Debugging, insbesondere mit Sensoren, Schnittstellen wie UART, CAN, SPI oder I2C sowie der Analyse von Logs und Fehlerbildern auf Zielhardware.

  • Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie die Bereitschaft, technische Lösungen und Wissen nachvollziehbar zu dokumentieren und weiterzugeben.

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Hardwareentwicklung und technischen Fachbereichen sowie Interesse daran, Software direkt am realen System zu testen.

  • Bereitschaft zur regelmäßigen Arbeit vor Ort sowie zur Teilnahme an Flugtests und gelegentlichen Kundeneinsätzen.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse

Nice to have

  • Kenntnisse in ArduPilot oder PX4, MAVLink oder DroneCAN.

  • Wissen in Regelungstechnik, Zustandsschätzung oder Navigation, beispielsweise mit EKF, GNSS oder RTK.

  • Erfahrung mit Open Source Projekten und ein entsprechendes GitHub Profil.

  • Erste Erfahrung als technischer Lead oder im Mentoring jüngerer Entwickler.

  • Erfahrung mit Luftfahrt oder Verteidigungsprojekten sowie Kenntnisse relevanter Safety Standards.

  • Praktische Drohnen Flugerfahrung oder EU Kompetenznachweis A1/A3 beziehungsweise A2.

Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung?

Wenn du Embedded Software nicht nur entwickeln, sondern direkt in innovativen Drohnensystemen zum Einsatz bringen möchtest und dabei echte technische Verantwortung übernehmen willst, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf.

In einem kurzen, unverbindlichen Telefonat geben wir dir anschließend alle weiteren Informationen zur Position und zum Unternehmen.

data.title: Sales Manager
data.description:
Über humbee solutions GmbH

Burghardt Garske und Ralf Bönning haben humbee 2017 mit dem Ziel gegründet, klassisches Dokumentenmanagement einfacher, flexibler und verständlicher zu gestalten. Unser Team aus 11 bis 50 Mitarbeitenden entwickelt in Meerbusch eine Software, die Zeit spart, die Zusammenarbeit vereinfacht und Innovation beschleunigt. data.description:
Werkstudent (m/w/d) Unternehmensentwicklung

Genau dafür suchen wir dich: als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Unternehmensentwicklung. Unser Büro liegt direkt an der LMU, mitten in München.

Cyrus Digital ist eine Boutique-Agentur für Performance Marketing. Wir verwalten jeden Tag 150.000 € Werbebudget. Wir betreuen bekannte D2C-Marken wie Luxusbetten24, Pammys, PHC Beauty und Freiluftkind. Wir sind ein kleines Team. Jeder hier kann viel und leistet viel.

Aufgaben

  • Du bist die rechte Hand des Geschäftsführers. Du weißt, was in der Firma läuft und woran wir gerade arbeiten. Du hilfst ihm dabei, das Unternehmen zu führen.

  • Du lernst Stakeholder-Management. Vom Dienstleister bis zum eigenen Team: Du stimmst dich ab, hakst nach und sorgst dafür, dass Dinge erledigt werden.

  • Du hältst das Backend zusammen. Rechnungen, Buchhaltung, Verträge, Termine, Reports, Steuerberater. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles läuft. Und du sagst Bescheid, wenn etwas nicht stimmt.

  • Du denkst mit, packst an und löst Dinge selbst.

Benefits

data.description:
Deine Benefits

Als IT Systemadministrator verantwortest du den zuverlässigen Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung der internen IT-Infrastruktur.

  • Min. 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der IT Systemadministration, idealerweise mit eigenständiger Betreuung von IT Umgebungen.

  • Praxis in der Administration von Firewalls und grundlegenden Netzwerkkomponenten.

  • Idealerweise abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im IT Bereich.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichen-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit VPN Lösungen und deren Konfiguration und Administration.

  • Kenntnisse im Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

  • Zusätzliches Know-How im Bereich IT Security.

data.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
data.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.

Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
  • Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
  • Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
  • Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
  • Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
  • Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
  • Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
  • Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
  • Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
  • You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
  • You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
  • Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
  • Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
  • Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
  • Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
  • Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
  • Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
  • Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

  • Mentoring: Du unterstützt weniger erfahrene Kollegen bei fachlichen Fragestellungen, teilst Dein Wissen und gibst konstruktives Feedback

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, triffst fundierte Entscheidungen und behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick

Was erwartet Dich noch?

Ein abwechslungsreicher und vielseitiger Job in einem der (aus unserer Sicht) spannendsten Themengebiete überhaupt. Und das in einem Unternehmen, in dem wirklich jede Meinung gehört und geschätzt wird – vom Praktikanten bis zur Geschäftsführung. Bei uns gibt es (natürlich) kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks, aber das ist heutzutage Standard. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten helfen Dir, auch auf Unvorhergesehenes im Alltag gelassen zu reagieren. Schau dir unsere Benefits gerne auf unserer Karriereseite genauer an.

Was erwartet Dich noch? Wir pflegen eine offene, vertrauensvolle Unternehmenskultur (schau mal auf Kununu) und schätzen eigenständiges Arbeiten, natürlich auch, aber nicht nur im Home-Office. Schließlich haben wir ein modernes Büro in Garching mit sensationellem Alpenblick, in dem wir gerne gemeinsam Mittagsessen und uns mit unseren Security-Auditoren, Incident-Respondern, Awareness-Trainern und Multimedia-Designern austauschen.

data.description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

As a Senior Field Service Engineer, you are the senior technical authority in the field for keeping Orbem's systems running reliably, at customer sites and in our own labs. You own the end-to-end resolution of complex, unplanned service incidents from start to finish, acting as the escalation point when others can't crack a problem. You adapt solutions to local site conditions, mentor junior Field Engineers, and help build the maintenance playbooks that don't fully exist yet. You're also fully qualified to guide installation efforts when the team needs additional senior capacity, making you one of the most versatile and trusted members of our Field Operations team.

Note: Travel is required up to 70% (mainly in the EU); a European driver's license is required.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Own end-to-end diagnosis and resolution of complex, previously unresolved, or urgent service incidents at customer sites and in our internal labs, without needing to escalate for a resolution.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for difficult repairs raised by junior Field Engineers or Field Service Engineers, and the go-to technical contact for suppliers/partners on-site.

  • Thoughtfully tailor maintenance and troubleshooting approaches to local site conditions, documenting the rationale for any deviation from standard procedure.

  • Own the creation and continuous improvement of maintenance and service SOPs/checklists, driving the PDCA cycle for the servicing function.

  • Mentor and coach junior Field Engineers/Field Service Engineers on troubleshooting best practices and technical judgment.

  • Lead Site Visit Checklist execution and technical problem-solving during installation and upgrade projects when deployed as senior surge capacity.

  • Act as the primary technical feedback loop to Engineering, interpreting field/lab findings, escalating risks, and proposing solutions rather than just reporting raw data.

Your responsibilities include:

Trusted to own the technical resolution of complex, high-stakes service incidents from first response through root cause, supplier coordination, and documentation, while serving as the senior technical anchor for the wider Field Operations team across both servicing and installation work.

Your Experience and Skills

  • You have significant, hands-on experience diagnosing and resolving complex electrical, mechanical, or automation issues in an industrial or field-service environment, ideally including experience as the senior/primary troubleshooter on a team.

  • You have strong working knowledge of electrical diagrams, AutoCAD, and automation/networking concepts (PLC, Modbus, or similar).

  • You are comfortable being the final escalation point for urgent, unplanned technical issues, making autonomous, well-reasoned decisions under time pressure without waiting for sign-off.

  • You have experience mentoring, training, or informally guiding less experienced technical colleagues.

  • You have experience creating or improving technical SOPs, checklists, or maintenance processes, not just executing them.

  • You are willing to travel extensively and can react to short-notice, urgent dispatch needs, including occasional weekend or after-hours support.

  • You hold, or are willing to obtain, relevant electrical/technical certifications (e.g. EFK-equivalent).

  • You are fluent in English (written and spoken), our working language.

  • You are fluent in Italian (written and spoken), enabling direct, seamless support for our growing base of Italian customers and sites.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience servicing MRI systems, medical devices, or other highly regulated industrial equipment; a track record of standing up a maintenance function or service SOPs from scratch in a scale-up environment.

  • Additional working proficiency in German and/or Spanish is a strong plus, further extending our on-site language coverage across Europe.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

data.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers telemonitoring solutions in oncology, psychiatry, and gastroenterology, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 42,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

In Germany, Resilience Care started building the market for telemonitoring in 2025. We work with university hospitals, hospital groups and medical practices, run clinical studies at German sites, and are actively involved in shaping the framework for telemonitoring reimbursement.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

As our first Senior Sales Manager in Germany, you own new-business sales for our telemonitoring solutions: you build the pipeline, lead complex sales cycles with medical practices, hospitals and hospital groups, and close the contracts that bring telemonitoring into routine care. You work directly with the General Manager Germany and help build the German sales organisation from the ground up, with a path to Head of Sales Germany as we scale.

Your impact

The German market for telemonitoring is taking shape now. The providers you win will become our reference sites, and the sales playbook you build will be the foundation the team grows on.

Your day-to-day

  • Identify target practices, hospitals and hospital groups, build your own pipeline, and turn leads into qualified opportunities together with the General Manager, the Key Account Managers and Marketing.

  • Lead the full sales cycle with chief physicians, nursing leadership, management, IT/data protection and procurement — from the first meeting to a signed contract, including group-level agreements and public tenders.

  • Run product demonstrations and negotiate commercial terms, working closely with the General Manager on key deals.

  • Plan and carry out the handover of newly signed sites with the Deployment and Key Account teams.

  • Build your clinical knowledge and network, and represent Resilience at medical congresses and professional events.

  • Keep pipeline and forecast up to date in the CRM, and feed market insights back into our offer, pricing and product.

You also collaborate with our colleagues in France who deployed our solutions there at scale.

  • Entrepreneurial: you enjoy building something from scratch and want to grow into leading the team.

  • Able to support changes in clinical teams’ established ways of working.

📃 What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in closing complex B2B deals with several decision-makers and long sales cycles, with a proven record of measurable results against targets.

Nice to have

data.title: Country Executive
data.description:
The finance function is broken. Everyone building for it is boring.

Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job.

Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week.

What we don't have is a single person on the ground in your country.


THIS IS NOT A COUNTRY MANAGER ROLE.

Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck, and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else.

No entity. No local team. No local playbook. You are Light's first boots on the ground in your market, and within a year you should know that market's complexity - its rules, its buyers, its excuses - better than anyone else. It's not a leadership title. It's the seed of one. Do this right and there's a real path: stand up an entity, hire a team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING.

  • Sitting across from finance leaders. Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You find out what they actually need - the thing behind the thing they asked for - and you come back with it written down clearly enough for engineers to build against.

  • Being the connective tissue. Customer, product, commercial. What you learn in-market changes how Light builds and how Light sells. You are the wire between them, and the wire has to carry current in both directions.

  • Owning the local rulebook. Compliance, regulation, filing, the specific ways finance is done badly in your country. You're the person in the room who genuinely knows this, and you make sure it shows up in the product and in the pitch.

  • Having a public point of view. Ideally you arrive with a finance background and an opinion on what "doing finance right" looks like here. Bring it into the market, into the roadmap, and into how every prospect sees Light. Relationships, events, brand presence - built from zero, by you.

  • Closing, with London behind you. Our sales team helps you manage and push deals over the line. You bring the market and customer understanding that makes those conversations land. They support you; they don't carry you and you don't carry it alone.

HOW WE'LL KEEP SCORE.

This isn't a pure revenue seat, but growing your country's ARR is the primary goal and you're tied directly to that number. A starting point will be set on what you're measured against on day one and you have to prove your worth.


WHAT WE'LL ASK FOR.

  • The thing you built from nothing. A company, a market, a GTM motion, a product. Something that existed because you hacked through a messy sale with no playbook. First question in the first call.

  • Credibility in front of a CFO. A finance background ideally, or enough substance that a finance leader takes you seriously the moment you walk in. You can't be the voice of the market without an ear for the buyer.

  • 2+ years as a founder or co-founder. Ex-founder or very early operator. We want the scar tissue.

  • 6+ years somewhere fast. High-growth tech, top-tier strategy consulting, investment banking, or similar. Or a body of work that makes the number irrelevant.

  • Structured thinking under mess. Exceptional analytical instincts, applied to markets nobody has mapped for you yet.

  • Fluency in your market's language and in English. Both, properly.

Extra credit: exposure to accounting, enterprise software, fintech or SaaS as a user, buyer or advisor; time spent presenting to senior finance stakeholders; an existing finance network in your market - or a demonstrated, unembarrassed intent to build one.


THE GOOD STUFF.

💸 Competitive salary plus potential stock options.
🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays where you're based.
🚀 A genuine chance to build a market from the ground up and grow with it.
🥳 Regular socials and company off-sites - the last one was in Italy.
🌍 Time with the team in London, Copenhagen, Munich, NY, Paris and wherever the action is.


HOW TO APPLY.

Show us who you are, not just your CV. Tell us what you built and what it did in numbers. Then answer the only question that matters: why this one? Anyone can say they want to work at a startup. A generic AI-written cover letter with no craft behind the prompt will be obvious - and is its own kind of answer.

If this reads as too much scope for one person: it is. That's the seat.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

data.title: Detection Engineer
data.description:
Artemis is building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, helping companies defend themselves effectively in an era where AI is fighting AI on the cyber battlefield.

Our platform brings a new approach to the $100B security operations market, building a live model of each customer's environment and using AI agents to detect, investigate, hunt, and respond to threats at machine speed. Just one year after our founding, Artemis is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies of all time, with customers including multiple Fortune 500 companies, Global 2000 enterprises, and AI innovators like Cursor.

We have raised $70M from Felicis, First Round Capital, Theory Ventures, Two Sigma Ventures, Lockstep VC and Brightmind. We are also backed by some of the most prominent operators in cybersecurity, including the CEO of Crowdstrike, the former CEO and CTO of Splunk, and the founders of Abnormal AI and Demisto.

Artemis's founders have built and scaled security products used by tens of thousands of customers. Shachar Hirshberg (CEO) led Amazon GuardDuty, the world's largest cloud detection product, was an early employee at Demisto, the company that invented the SOAR category, was an engineering leader at Palo Alto Networks, and holds an MBA from Harvard. Dan Shiebler (CTO) led all AI and machine learning at Abnormal AI, the pioneer of behavior-based detection, spent five years building analytics using machine learning and vector databases at Twitter, and holds a PhD in machine learning from Oxford.

Our team of software engineers, AI researchers, security engineers, and product designers comes from Google, Meta, AWS, Wiz, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Abnormal AI, Perplexity, Bridgewater, Mercor, CERN, and more.

We're growing fast and looking for builders who want to help us serve our rapidly expanding customer base.

About the Role

We're looking for a Detection Engineer to own the detection content that powers the Artemis platform. You'll design, build, test, and continuously tune high-fidelity detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments — treating detection as code, and using AI as a force multiplier at every step: authoring rules with AI assistance, and building anomaly detections that learn what's normal in each environment and flag what isn't. Detections at Artemis don't just fire alerts; they feed an AI-native investigation pipeline, so precision, rich context, and machine-readable output matter as much as coverage. This is a hands-on engineering role where every rule you ship directly determines what threats we catch for customers and how fast we catch them.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the detection library - Design, implement, and own high-fidelity detections across cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity (Okta, Entra ID), endpoint (EDR), and SaaS log sources, from hypothesis to production.

  • Practice detection-as-code - Manage detection content like software: version-controlled rules, peer review, automated validation and testing, and CI/CD deployment across customer environments.

  • Map and close coverage gaps - Measure detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, prioritize gaps based on real-world threat activity, and systematically close them.

  • Validate against real attacks - Build and run attack simulations and test harnesses to prove detections fire on true positives and stay quiet on benign activity, before and after they ship.

  • Tune relentlessly - Own false-positive and false-negative rates across the fleet: analyze detection performance data, tune noisy logic at the source, and sunset detections that no longer earn their keep.

  • Use AI to write detections at scale - Leverage AI throughout the detection lifecycle: use AI-assisted workflows to author, convert, test, and document rules faster than any traditional team could, and build the tooling that makes AI-generated detection content trustworthy enough to ship.

  • Build behavioral and anomaly-based detections - Go beyond static signatures: establish behavioral baselines of normal activity per environment (identity, cloud, SaaS usage patterns) and engineer anomaly detections that surface deviations — impossible travel, unusual privilege use, novel API activity — with high signal and low noise.

  • Engineer detections for AI-powered investigation - Design detections that produce rich, structured context so the Artemis platform can investigate and resolve cases autonomously.

  • Turn intelligence into detections - Translate threat intelligence, incident findings, and threat hunt results from our research and SOC teams into durable, behavioral detection logic.

  • Partner with the SOC and research teams - Close the loop with Apollo analysts and security researchers: use case outcomes and analyst feedback to drive detection improvements, and give them documentation that makes every alert investigable.

  • Support customer-specific tuning - Adapt and tune detection content to each customer's environment and business context, reducing noise without sacrificing coverage.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience, with significant time in detection engineering

  • Proven track record designing, building, and tuning detections at scale across SIEM, EDR, or custom detection platforms

  • Strong proficiency in detection languages and formats such as Sigma, KQL, SPL, or YARA-L, and comfort writing code (Python preferred) for automation and testing

  • Deep knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (MITRE ATT&CK) and how they manifest in logs across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS telemetry

  • Experience with detection-as-code workflows: Git, peer review, automated testing, and CI/CD for detection content

  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate detection authoring, tuning, or validation — and judgment about when AI-generated logic is ready to ship

  • Experience building behavioral or anomaly-based detections: establishing baselines of normal activity and engineering detections that flag meaningful deviations

  • Strong log-analysis skills and demonstrated ability to distinguish malicious activity from benign noise across diverse data sources

  • Clear written and verbal communication — able to document detection logic and explain coverage and trade-offs to engineers, analysts, and customers

Bonus

  • Experience in an MDR, MSSP, or high-volume SOC environment

  • Experience with attack simulation and validation frameworks (Atomic Red Team, purple teaming)

  • Background in threat hunting or incident response across cloud environments

  • Experience with UEBA platforms or statistical/ML-based detection methods (peer grouping, time-series baselining, outlier scoring)

  • Experience building AI-assisted detection or investigation tooling from scratch

  • Contributions to open-source detection content or the broader detection engineering community

Why Work at Artemis?

  • Make a real world impact. You'll lead the human layer of defense that protects real companies. Every standard you set and process you sharpen raises the quality of protection customers depend on.

  • Be challenged to be better than ever before. Our team includes some of the smartest and most driven people in the world. We guarantee you will learn more in 1 year here than 10 years in another place.

  • Push the boundaries of technology. Lead a SOC built on the most advanced AI capabilities in cybersecurity, where the platform automates detection, investigation, and tuning, and your team owns the expertise, response, and relationship. You'll define what a modern, AI-native MDR looks like.

  • Innovative culture. We obsess about customers, move fast with high quality, and value open communication, mentorship and learning. You'll have the autonomy to shape the direction of the operation and own outcomes, not just run a runbook.

If you are passionate about cyber security and want to build and lead the team at the cutting edge of AI-powered defense, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation of $160,000-190,000 per year, and a top-of-market equity component. A variety of factors are considered when determining the compensation, including a candidate's professional experience. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed.

Equal Opportunity

At Artemis, we believe the best ideas come from diverse teams. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can do their best work. We welcome everyone, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, identity, or anything else that makes you, you.

Dan Shiebler (CTO) led all AI and machine learning at Abnormal AI, the pioneer of behavior-based detection, spent five years building analytics using machine learning and vector databases at Twitter, and holds a PhD in machine learning from Oxford.

About the Role

Most companies treat technology alliances as a nice-to-have. At Artemis, alliances are closer to how the product works. Our platform runs on AWS and reasons over telemetry that lives in other vendors' systems: EDR, SIEM, identity, cloud, and the pipelines that move security data between them. Every one of those vendors is simultaneously an integration, a channel, and a reason a customer picks us. The companies we plug into are the companies we go to market with.

We're hiring a Technology Alliances Manager to own that motion end to end, with three tracks front and center:

  • Hyperscalers. AWS first: we build on it and our customers run on it. Own the relationship end to end: Marketplace transactability and private offers, co-sell through ISV Accelerate, competency milestones, and the AWS field teams who can put us in front of their accounts.

  • Security platforms. The largest vendors in security (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, and their peers) already collect the telemetry we investigate. Build the alliances that position Artemis as a multiplier on their platforms: partnership agreements, store listings, certified integrations, and field-level co-sell.

  • ISVs. The vendors that shape and route security data (Cribl and its peers) as well as domain specific security companies helps us secure customers together. Build the reference architectures and joint plays that helps customers stay safe.

Many of these relationships are already in motion at the executive level. Your job is to take them from conversations to signed, integrated, revenue-producing partnerships, and to decide what we pursue next.

We're not collecting logos. A partnership counts when it produces something measurable: sourced pipeline, marketplace revenue, an integration customers actually turn on, a partner seller who pulls us into a deal. You'll be measured on those outcomes, and you'll have the product, engineering, and executive support to hit them.

Responsibilities

  • Own the technology partner map: which partners, in what order, for what outcome; double down on what performs and kill what doesn't

  • Run the AWS motion end to end: Marketplace listing and private offers, co-sell pipeline, program and competency milestones, and joint content with AWS field and specialist teams

  • Build and negotiate alliances with the major security platforms: agreements, integration roadmaps, marketplace listings, and better-together assets (solution briefs, reference architectures, joint demos) that sales actually uses

  • Drive integrations from scoping to launch with product and engineering on both sides, and make sure every launch ships with a go-to-market moment, not just a docs page

  • Turn partnerships into revenue: joint account mapping, co-sell registrations, warm intros, MDF, and partner events (RSA, re:Invent, Fal.Con, Black Hat), with tracking of alliance-sourced and alliance-influenced pipeline

  • Bring partner and market signal back into product roadmap and positioning

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Artemis transacts on AWS Marketplace with an active co-sell motion and registered opportunities flowing in both directions

  • Two or three anchor alliances with major security vendors are signed, integrated, and producing referred deals

  • Every anchor partner has a better-together kit our sales team actually pulls up in live deals

  • Alliance-sourced and alliance-influenced pipeline is a tracked, growing number the whole company can see

Move at rocket speed, build something massive.

Artemis is an early-stage cybersecurity company solving problems that matter, against adversaries that don't slow down. As our founding Technology Alliances Manager, you'll shape how Artemis plugs into the rest of the security stack and how customers experience us alongside every other tool they run. You'll have full ownership, real autonomy, and a direct line to leadership. The pace is fast, the bar is high, and the impact is direct.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in technology alliances, partnerships, or business development at a cybersecurity or enterprise infrastructure company

  • At least one partnership you built from zero and can walk us through in numbers: what it sourced, influenced, or unlocked

  • Hands-on hyperscaler experience: you've listed and transacted on a cloud marketplace, worked programs like AWS ISV Accelerate, and know how co-sell and partner funding actually operate

  • Fluency in the security ecosystem: the major platforms across EDR/XDR, SIEM, identity, and data pipeline, how they interoperate, and what their partner organizations optimize for

  • Range: technical enough to whiteboard an integration with partner engineers, commercial enough to negotiate the agreement behind it, credible with partner executives

  • Judgment for coopetition: some of our most important partners also ship competing products, and you know how to build the better-together lane anyway

  • Comfort with ambiguity, building from scratch, and moving fast without dropping details

Nice to Have

  • Time inside the partner organization of a hyperscaler or major security platform: you know how AWS, CrowdStrike, or Palo Alto Networks evaluate ISV partners from the inside

  • Existing relationships across the security partner ecosystem

  • Experience as a company's first alliances hire

  • Familiarity with partner ecosystem tooling (Crossbeam, Tackle, WorkSpan, and similar)

data.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/x)
data.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming, leading one of its largest innovations, a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences.

Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
  • Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.
  • Take new growth opportunities from first hypothesis to go/no-go decision, across product, market expansion, partnerships, and distribution.
  • Lead a high-quality experimentation process by defining hypotheses, designing statistically sound A/B tests, interpreting results, and making data-driven product decisions.
  • Partner closely with your dedicated Data Analyst to uncover opportunities, validate assumptions, and continuously improve product performance.
  • Work with Engineering, Design, Commercial, User Acquisition, Customer Support, Fraud, and Leadership to align priorities and deliver impactful product improvements.
  • Represent your product domain directly to leadership, using data, customer insights, and business context to influence strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.
  • Growth metrics measurably improve: Your product strategy and experimentation drive meaningful improvements in activation, retention, and long-term user profitability.
  • Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
  • You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
  • You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
  • Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
  • Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
  • Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
  • Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
  • Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
  • Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
  • Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

data.title: CRM & E-Mail Marketing Manager (gn)
data.description:
Deine Mission

  • Du verantwortest den operativen und strategischen Auf- und Ausbau unserer CRM- und E-Mail-Marketing-Aktivitäten mit Fokus auf Lead-Rückgewinnung und Re-Engagement
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst mehrstufige Marketing-Automation-Kampagnen über Email, SMS und WhatsApp (Nurturing, Onboarding, Win-Back, Retention) und stellst deren saubere Auswertbarkeit sicher
  • Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings mit KPI-Analysen und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab
  • Du führst Zielgruppen- und Segmentierungsanalysen durch, um schlafende Leads zu identifizieren und unsere Kommunikationsstrategie kontinuierlich zu schärfen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit mit Bereichen, wie Sales, Produkt und Content, um kanalübergreifend konsistente Botschaften zu gewährleisten und Lead-Qualität sowie Timing zu optimieren

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im E-Mail Marketing oder CRM mit, idealerweise im B2C-Umfeld oder mit Consumer-Services

data.title: Computer Vision & AI Engineer - Interceptor C‑UAS (m/f/d)
data.description:
About the role:

At Quantum Systems, we are building highly autonomous interceptor systems that must perceive, decide, and act under extreme latency, motion, and environmental constraints.

We are looking for a Computer Vision & AI Engineer to drive the perception stack of our Counter-UAS interceptor platform. You will work on low-latency camera pipelines, small-object detection, object tracking, sensor fusion, visual odometry, precision landing, camera calibration, embedded inference, and data pipelines for training and validation.

This role is suited for someone with a strong academic or practical background in computer vision, AI, robotics, or perception systems. A Master’s degree is expected; a PhD is a strong plus. We are open to ambitious early-career candidates if they bring strong technical depth, practical implementation skills, and the ability to own complex perception problems.

Your Mission

You will develop the vision and AI pipeline that turns raw camera data into actionable perception outputs for autonomous flight. This includes low-latency detection and tracking, motion-aware vision, sensor fusion with inertial data, 3D direction-vector estimation, GPS-denied navigation, and precision landing support.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Bring up, optimize, and maintain high-performance camera pipelines, including CSI camera interfaces, raw image access, buffering, synchronization, and latency reduction.

  • Develop detection algorithms for small and difficult-to-see objects in moving and rotating camera images.

  • Combine machine learning and classical computer vision approaches where appropriate.

  • Fuse inertial data, motion information, and visual data to improve detection and tracking in moving image sequences.

  • Build object tracking pipelines that can switch from initial detection to low-latency tracking once a target has been acquired.

  • Optimize perception pipelines for embedded execution on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

  • Work toward high frame-rate processing targets in the range of 100–300 FPS, where technically feasible.

  • Use camera intrinsics and extrinsics to transform image-space detections into 3D direction vectors or other navigation-relevant outputs.

  • Work on GPS-denied navigation concepts using visual odometry, including approaches with forward-facing camera views rather than only downward-looking cameras.

  • Develop visual support for precision landing, including height estimation, velocity estimation, and motion-state estimation from limited camera perspectives.

  • Build and maintain the data pipeline from onboard recordings to cloud storage, preprocessing, annotation, dataset generation, training, validation, and benchmarking.

  • Work with annotation tools such as SuperAnnotate, CVAT, Label Studio, or comparable systems.

  • Benchmark and evaluate different model and algorithm families, including approaches such as CenterNet, SuperPoint, SuperGlue, optical flow, feature tracking, object detection, and lightweight embedded models.

  • Build deployment pipelines using ONNX, TensorRT, custom inference runners, or comparable embedded inference tooling.

  • Collaborate closely with autonomy, flight control, embedded software, test, and systems engineering teams.



What you bring to the team:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in computer vision, AI, robotics, machine learning, electrical engineering, computer science, aerospace engineering, or a comparable technical field.

  • Strong understanding of computer vision fundamentals, camera geometry, feature detection, object detection, tracking, calibration, and image-space to 3D transformations.

  • Practical experience implementing computer vision or machine learning pipelines in Python and C++.

  • Experience with embedded inference, ideally on NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, GStreamer, V4L2, or similar technologies.

  • Ability to read, understand, and implement ideas from current research papers.

  • Understanding of latency, throughput, profiling, memory movement, and real-time constraints.

  • Experience with dataset creation, annotation workflows, training/validation splits, metrics, and benchmarking.

  • Strong mathematical intuition and willingness to debug both algorithms and real-world sensor data.

  • Ability to take ownership of a technical area and drive it from research prototype to flight-test-ready software.

    • Experience with UAV perception, robotics perception, visual odometry, SLAM, sensor fusion, or tracking systems.

    • Experience with IMU-camera fusion, ego-motion compensation, rolling-shutter effects, or high-frame-rate cameras.

    • Experience with precision landing, visual navigation, or GPS-denied navigation.

    • Experience building cloud-based ML training and validation pipelines.

    • Publications, thesis work, GitHub projects, demos, or competition results in computer vision, robotics, AI, or autonomous systems.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

As a System Test Engineer (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and operational performance of our unmanned systems (aircraft, vehicle).You will develop a deep understanding of our products, their system & software architecture, hardware components, interfaces, and operational use cases. Based on system and software requirements, you will define effective verification strategies, specify test cases, and execute tests across different test environments (simulation and hardware-in-the-loop setups).

This position combines analytical system thinking, hands-on testing, and test automation. You will work closely with software, systems, hardware, simulation, and flight-test teams to identify risks, uncover defects, and provide objective evidence that our products meet their intended requirements. By continuously improving our verification methods, test coverage, and automation, you will contribute directly to the safety, reliability, and successful release of our next-generation unmanned aircraft systems.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop a test strategy to validate our entire software stack for unmanned systems (vertical take-off and landing aircraft (VTOL), unmanned ground vehicle).

  • Understand the architecture, functionality, interfaces, and operational behavior of our unmanned systems.

  • Evaluate and develop AI-powered testing solutions, including AI agent-based systems, to automate test implementation, improve test generation, and increase the efficiency of our verification processes.

  • Create new end-to-end integration tests.

  • Review, challenge, and optimize existing test cases.

  • Proactively expand test coverage in a structured way to identify and push system limits.

  • Develop an automated test framework that enables developers to continuously extend the test suite.

  • Execute functional, integration, regression, robustness, and end-to-end system tests in SIL, HIL, and real-system environments.

  • Work closely with software developers, systems engineers, hardware engineers, simulation teams, flight-test teams, and product stakeholders.



What you bring to the team:

  • A successfully completed degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or a comparable qualification (e.g., ISTQB certification)

  • 3+ years of experience in system / software testing or working in similar role

  • Experience analyzing system and software requirements and deriving traceable verification artefacts using requirements management tools

  • Strong understanding of complex system architectures and experience executing and troubleshooting end-to-end tests across software and hardware components

  • Practical experience in building hardware/software-in-the-loop setups, from concept to implementation

  • Interest or experience in AI-assisted test specification / software development, Large Language Models (LLMs), or AI agent frameworks applied to software testing and automation is a strong plus.

  • Proficiency in developing, optimizing and maintaining automated test cases using Python or a comparable language

  • Hands-on experience with Robot test automation framework

  • Experience with CI/CD tools (ideally GitHub) and Docker

  • Experience with DO-178C is advantageous

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Proactive, organized and a team player mindset

  • Ability to balance multiple assignments

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. data.title: (Senior) ML Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
data.description:
As a Senior Machine Learning Platform Engineer (m/f/d), you will design and build the platform that turns large-scale UxV and sensor data into validated, reproducible machine learning models.

You will own and improve the end-to-end ML lifecycle—from data processing, selection, and annotation through distributed model training, experiment tracking and validation. Your work will enable ML engineers to develop autonomy and perception capabilities efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

Beyond conventional platform engineering, you will also apply modern AI models to our internal data workflows. This may include semantic dataset search, automated metadata generation, data curation, and auto-labeling using foundation and multimodal models.

By creating the foundations on which our AI teams build and validate models, you will directly contribute to Quantum Systems’ next generation of autonomous UxV solutions.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, implement, and operate scalable ML and data pipelines covering ingestion, dataset creation, training, and model validation.

  • Build a reliable ML platform for reproducible experimentation and training across local, on-premises, and cloud GPU infrastructure.

  • Develop efficient systems for large-scale multimodal datasets, including imagery, LiDAR, odometry, ground truth, and simulation data.

  • Establish dataset and model versioning, metadata management, quality checks, and traceability from raw sensor data to validated model artifacts.

  • Build and optimize distributed training workflows, job scheduling, GPU resource allocation, caching, and high-throughput data access.

  • Develop AI-powered tools for internal data engineering, including semantic data search, metadata enrichment, automatic annotation, and quality assessment using foundation or multimodal models.

  • Improve platform reliability, observability, security, cost efficiency, and developer experience.

  • Collaborate with ML, data, and engineering teams to translate their technical needs into scalable platform capabilities.

  • Mentor engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, and establish engineering standards for production-grade ML systems.



What you bring to the team:

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • You have strong software engineering skills in Python and experience building reliable, maintainable software and automated workflows for data-intensive machine learning systems.

  • You have several years of hands-on experience building production ML platforms, MLOps systems, or large-scale data and training pipelines.

  • Solid knowledge of machine learning fundamentals and hands-on experience training and evaluating ML models.

  • You have a deep understanding of the ML lifecycle, including dataset preparation, distributed training, experiment management, model validation, and reproducibility.

  • You have experience with cloud platforms and containerized infrastructure using Docker and Kubernetes.

  • You have worked with workflow orchestration, experiment tracking, and model or artifact management technologies such as Argo Workflows, Kubeflow, Metaflow, Airflow, MLflow, or comparable solutions.

  • You have practical experience with large datasets, object and shared storage, data formats, partitioning or sharding strategies, and high-throughput data loading.

  • You are familiar with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring, logging, access control, and operating reliable production systems.

  • You communicate confidently in English and collaborate effectively across research, product, and infrastructure teams.

  • You are highly self-motivated and take technical ownership from architecture through operation.
