data.title: (Senior) GenAI Engineer (f/m/d)
data.description:
At Trusted Shops, we’re shaping Europe’s Community of Trust – a space where Businesses and Consumers connect with confidence, transparency, and security. Every day, millions of Users and thousands of Companies across Europe trust us to deliver safe, reliable, and seamless digital experiences.

To realize this ambitious Vision, we see Artificial Intelligence not as a trend but as a core driver of our future. AI is essential to how we solve complex challenges, scale our operations, and create customer experiences that are not just efficient but truly intelligent.
We’re growing our AI capabilities with an AI-first mindset – where AI is integrated from the ground up, powering the Solutions of tomorrow.

To join our AI Solutions Team, we are looking for a:

(Senior) GenAI Engineer (f/m/d)

Germany (remote) | Permanent Contract (Full-time)


Now, we’re taking the next step: shaping the future of Agentic Commerce – a future where AI doesn’t just support decisions, but acts with purpose, responsibility, and impact.


Your Key Responsibilities:

In our AI Solutions Team, you’ll play a key role in developing the intelligence that drives our Products, Services, and internal Processes forward

  • Build production-ready GenAI systems: Train, fine-tune, and deploy models for business-critical use cases like churn prediction, content generation, and trust scoring. Take full ownership of end-to-end AI solutions

  • Develop autonomous AI agents: Design agents that make informed decisions, interact with users and systems, and integrate with tools and data sources using modular logic and the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

  • Implement advanced RAG & multi-agent systems: Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems and orchestrate multi-agent workflows using frameworks like LangGraph, AgentCore, or Strands Agents

  • Create scalable AI services: Package models into reusable APIs and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, REST APIs), making AI capabilities accessible across teams

  • Integrate with enterprise platforms: Connect AI solutions with HubSpot, Salesforce, proprietary tools, and other systems for seamless workflow automation

  • Ensure reliability, explainability & compliance: Deliver trustworthy, transparent, and compliant AI solutions aligned with company values

  • Leverage cloud-native architectures: Work with AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/Fargate) or other cloud platforms to build scalable AI pipelines


  • Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field or equivalent experience building production-grade GenAI systems

  • Proven experience deploying high-accuracy, scaled AI Systems in production, beyond PoCs or simple Chatbots

  • Hands-on experience with Agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration, including planning, tool usage, decision-making, and self-correction

  • Strong Python skills and experience with modern GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.), vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, pgvector), and embedding strategies

  • Experience building robust APIs and serverless AI Services (FastAPI, REST) with async patterns, error handling, and scalability in mind

  • Practical experience with cloud AI/ML Services (AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/Fargate) or equivalent cloud environments

  • Data-driven and pragmatic mindset: delivering production-ready solutions with measurable impact

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus

  • Collaborative, curious, and purpose-driven, ready to tackle complex AI challenges

What we offer you:

  • Hybrid work: Combine flexible remote work with team time in the Cologne office (on-site days depending on your location)

  • Workation: Temporarily work from a destination of your choice within the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Norway

  • Permanent contract with Europe's trusted brand

  • 28 vacation days + 2.5 additional days off at Christmas, New Year's Eve and Carnival

  • Buddy programme (an experienced trustee is at your side)

  • Individual training opportunities

  • Events (Team Events, Unit Events, etc.)

  • Health Pass (free online and offline sports, fitness and health courses)

data.title: Head of Product & Technology (AI) (m/w/d)
data.description:
Auf einen Blick

Arbeitsort: deutschlandweit oder in einem unserer Büros in München und Berlin
Arbeitsmodell: Remote deutschlandweit und zusätzlich bis zu drei Monate pro Jahr innerhalb Europas.
Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit  
Vertragsart: unbefristete Festanstellung
Vergütung: 120.000 - 150.000 Euro brutto pro Jahr auf Vollzeitbasis. Die konkrete Einordnung innerhalb der Spanne richtet sich nach relevanter Berufserfahrung, nachgewiesener fachlicher Tiefe und dem Umfang vergleichbarer Verantwortung.



Warum gibt es diese Stelle?

PIABO entwickelt eine eigene Softwareplattform, die internes Wissen und Abläufe für die Teams nutzbar macht. Erste Anwendungen sind bereits im Einsatz. Unser Anspruch ist, daraus ein verlässliches Produktportfolio zu entwickeln: Lösungen, die im Arbeitsalltag genutzt werden, einen nachvollziehbaren Nutzen stiften und sich bei belegter Wirkung für weitere Teams, Kundenprojekte oder neue Angebote eignen.

Damit diese Entwicklung gelingt, braucht es klare Entscheidungen darüber, welche Probleme Priorität haben und welche Lösungen verlässlich in den Einsatz kommen. Die Rolle verbindet Produkt- und Technologieentwicklung, gibt dem bestehenden fünfköpfigen Team aus Development und Project Management eine gemeinsame Richtung und verantwortet zugleich PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft.


Drei Must-haves für die Stelle

  • Produkt- und Business-Urteil: Du verbindest Produktentscheidungen mit konkretem Geschäftsnutzen.
  • Hands-on Engineering: Du bringst eigene Entwicklungserfahrung mit und beurteilst technische Qualität praktisch.
  • Führung und operative Verantwortung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Führung und einen verlässlichen IT-Betrieb.


Was du bei uns tust und wie

  • Portfolio und Priorisierung: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung zu Produkt- und Technologieentscheidungen. Du bewertest Vorhaben nach Geschäftswirkung, Machbarkeit, Risiken und Kapazität und übersetzt priorisierte Themen in realistische Umsetzungsetappen. Wenn Nutzen oder Voraussetzungen nicht tragen, machst du das transparent und empfiehlst Alternativen.
  • Use Cases und Erfolgskriterien: Gemeinsam mit den nutzenden Teams nimmst du konkrete Abläufe und Probleme auf, grenzt den Bedarf ein und legst fest, welchen Nutzen die Lösung schaffen soll und woran erfolgreiche Nutzung erkennbar wird.
  • Software entwickeln: Du baust selbst Prototypen und produktive Software mit AI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen, darunter Coding Agents und LLM-APIs. Du testest Annahmen früh und führst tragfähige Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz.
  • Technische Qualität sichern: Du verantwortest technische Konzepte und Qualitätsmaßstäbe: von Architektur, APIs, Datenflüssen und Integrationen bis zu Tests, Code-Reviews, Dokumentation und Übergabe in den Betrieb.
  • Team führen und entwickeln: Du führst das fünfköpfige Team aus Development und Project Management disziplinarisch. Du setzt gemeinsame Prioritäten und Qualitätsmaßstäbe, gibst Feedback und entwickelst Zusammenarbeit und fachliche Stärke weiter.
  • Einführung und Wirkung nachhalten: Du begleitest die Einführung in den nutzenden Teams und prüfst anhand der vereinbarten Erfolgssignale und Rückmeldungen, ob die Lösung im Alltag genutzt wird und den erwarteten Nutzen liefert. Daraus leitest du ab, was weiterentwickelt, skaliert oder beendet wird.
  • Operative IT verantworten: Du verantwortest PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft und koordinierst die zuständigen internen und externen Spezialist:innen. Du hältst Zuständigkeiten für verlässlichen Betrieb, Zugriffe, Security und Datenschutz klar und sorgst dafür, dass Fragen mit der nötigen Expertise bearbeitet werden.


Das bringst du mit

Die folgenden Erfahrungen sind für die Rolle erforderlich; unterschiedliche Karrierewege können passen:

  • Du bringst mindestens zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Software- und Produktentwicklung sowie mehrere Jahre eigene Entwicklungspraxis mit – zum Beispiel mit Node.js/TypeScript, Python oder Go. Du hast produktive Systeme selbst gebaut und betrieben.
  • Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding Agents und LLM-APIs (Agentic Engineering) und kannst ihre Leistungsfähigkeit und Grenzen einschätzen.
  • Du hast mindestens ein digitales Produkt von der Idee bis in den Betrieb verantwortet. An einem konkreten Beispiel kannst du zeigen, wie du bei offenen Anforderungen Vision, Roadmap und Prioritäten festgelegt, die Lösung in produktive Nutzung gebracht und anhand messbarer Ergebnisse die nächsten Schritte gesteuert hast.
  • Du hast ein Team disziplinarisch geführt und Mitarbeitende fachlich weiterentwickelt. Du arbeitest mit Geschäftsführung, Projektmanagement und Development auf Augenhöhe und challengst Anforderungen, wenn sie nicht zum Ziel beitragen.
  • Du hast den IT-Betrieb selbst verantwortet oder eng gesteuert – einschließlich Security, Zugriffsmanagement und Datenschutz.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1) und sehr gut Englisch (B2).


Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Du hast als CTO oder CPO in einem Startup gearbeitet oder ein technisches Unternehmen mit aufgebaut.
  • Du hast AI-Produkte oder -Plattformen über mehrere Geschäftsbereiche hinweg in die Nutzung gebracht oder skaliert.
  • Du hast SaaS-Produkte oder wiederverwendbare Software für Kundenprojekte verantwortet.


What’s in it for you?

Du steigst in ein bestehendes AI-Produktsetup ein: Erste Anwendungen sind im Einsatz und ein fünfköpfiges Team ist vorhanden. So kannst du die nächste Entwicklungsstufe mitgestalten, statt bei null anzufangen.

  • Nähe zur Geschäftsführung: Du tauschst dich direkt mit der Geschäftsführung aus und bringst deine Empfehlungen zu Produkt- und Technologieentscheidungen ein.
  • Business Impact: Deine Arbeit wirkt in PIABOs internen Abläufen, im New Business, in Kundenprojekten und in neuen Leistungsangeboten.
  • AI-Lernen: AI Bootcamp, moderner Tech Stack und Raum, AI in der eigenen Arbeit praktisch einzusetzen.
  • Umfeld: Eine Organisation, die etabliert und zugleich beweglich ist und AI als Grundlage für Produkte, Prozesse und Zusammenarbeit versteht.
  • Ausstattung und Benefits: Mac-Ausstattung, Urban Sports Club, JobRad und betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
Mehr zu unseren Benefits findest du hier.


Kontakt

Deine Ansprechperson: Dorian Baro

Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Teile stattdessen ein konkretes Beispiel aus deiner Produkt- oder Engineering-Arbeit. Links zu Demos, Produkten oder Code sind willkommen, sofern du sie teilen darfst.

data.title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
data.description:
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions
  • Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly
Nice to have:
  • Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software
  • Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products
  • Some front-end understanding — enough to work closely with engineers on feasibility and detail


How You’ll Grow

As the sole designer on a core product team, you'll set the design practice for Energy Insights largely on your own terms — there's no senior designer above you dictating process. You'll work closely enough with customers and engineers to see the direct consequences of your decisions, and as the product and team grow, you'll have the option to shape whether and how a design function scales beyond you.


What You Get

  • Real ownership: your designs define how industrial customers experience the product
  • Direct impact on a product that helps companies cut energy waste and costs
  • A small, senior-leaning team with short decision paths and close access to customers
  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Hybrid setup based in our Munich office, with regular in-person days alongside the team


The Application

Send us your CV and portfolio — we don't do long forms or generic cover letters. Surprise us.

data.title: Chief of Staff (m/w/x)
data.description:
About Doctorflix

Medizin entwickelt sich schneller als je zuvor, und Ärzte müssen ihr ganzes Berufsleben lang mithalten. Doctorflix ist die digitale Plattform, auf der Ärzte im deutschsprachigen Raum lernen: kostenlos, zertifiziert und mit dem größten Angebot im Markt. Weil wir dort sind, wo Ärzte ihr Wissen auf den neuesten Stand bringen, sind wir auch der Kanal, über den Pharma- und MedTech-Unternehmen sie relevant erreichen. Unsere Vision: die führende Plattform für medizinisches Wissen zu werden, zuerst in DACH, dann international. Ein Ort, an dem Ärzte lernen, sich austauschen und bessere Entscheidungen für ihre Patienten treffen. Wir sind ein VC-finanziertes Startup aus Berlin und wachsen organisch wie anorganisch.


Role

Wir sind aus der frühen Startup-Phase herausgewachsen: ein neues Sales-Team, neue Produkte, anorganisches Wachstum in Vorbereitung, der Schritt ins Ausland in Sicht. Was uns jetzt bremst, sind nicht fehlende Ideen, sondern Prozesse, die nicht mitwachsen.

Als Chief of Staff arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Gründern Hans und Leo und machst aus Strategie ein laufendes System. Du baust unsere Operations so um, dass sie bei doppelter Größe noch funktionieren, automatisierst, was kein Mensch mehr tun sollte, und übernimmst die Projekte, die über unser nächstes Jahr entscheiden.

Das ist weder eine Assistenzrolle noch ein reiner Strategie-Job. Du schreibst nicht die Folie über den Prozess. Du baust den Prozess und, wo es Sinn ergibt, den Agenten, der ihn ausführt.


Your tasks

Operations & Organisation für Scale

  • Du nimmst unsere Kernprozesse auseinander (Angebot bis Rechnung, Kampagnen-Go-live, Content-Produktion, Reporting) und baust sie neu: klare Ownership, saubere Übergaben, messbare Durchlaufzeiten.
  • Du etablierst unseren Operating Rhythm: OKR-Prozess mit Owner pro Key Result, Leadership-Meetings, KPI-Reviews, nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen.
  • Du professionalisierst die Organisation: Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, ein Tool-Stack, der zusammenspielt (ClickUp, Notion, Metabase, CRM), und genau die Regeln, die wir brauchen. Nicht mehr.
  • Gemeinsam mit Finance und externen Partnern machst du Backoffice-Prozesse wie Rechnungsstellung, Forderungsmanagement und Abschluss-Zulieferung robust.

Automatisierung & AI-Workflows

  • Du verantwortest unsere AI-native-Agenda: In jedem Team identifizierst du die Workflows mit dem größten Hebel, automatisierst sie und misst die Wirkung (Zeit, Fehlerquote, Durchlaufzeit).
  • Du baust selbst: Agenten und Automationen mit LLM-APIs (z. B. Claude), n8n, Make oder Zapier, Skripten und Schnittstellen zwischen unseren Systemen. Bei größeren Vorhaben steuerst du Product und Engineering.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass jede Automation dokumentiert ist, überwacht wird und einen Owner hat, statt nach drei Monaten still kaputtzugehen.

Strategische Sonderprojekte

  • M&A & Post-Merger-Integration: Du begleitest Zukäufe von der Due Diligence bis zur Integration. Teams, Kunden, Plattformen, Inhalte und Prozesse führst du mit einem 100-Tage-Plan und klaren Synergiezielen zusammen.
  • Internationalisierung: Du bereitest den Markteintritt außerhalb von DACH vor: Business Case, Markt- und Partneranalyse, operatives Playbook.
  • Themen, die heute niemand im Team ownt, die aber jemand ownen muss.

Führung

  • Du führst Teams und Projektgruppen bereichsübergreifend, je nach Phase auch interimistisch, etwa ein integriertes Team nach einem Zukauf.
  • Du forderst Teamleads heraus, ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen, und hältst nach, dass sie erreicht werden.

Fundraising & Investor Relations

  • Du unterstützt die Gründer bei Finanzierungsrunden: Equity Story, Finanzmodell, Datenraum, Due-Diligence-Fragen.
  • Du verantwortest Board-Unterlagen und das monatliche Investoren-Reporting inhaltlich mit.


Your profile

  • Operator: Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mehrere Jahre in operativer Verantwortung, z. B. in Operations, BizOps oder Founder's Office eines Scale-ups, als Gründer oder nach einem Start in Beratung, PE oder VC mit Wechsel ins Operative. Du hast Operations nachweislich auf- oder umgebaut, nicht nur analysiert.
  • Automator: Du kannst konkrete Prozesse zeigen, die du automatisiert hast, mit Vorher und Nachher. Du arbeitest sicher mit Low-Code-Tools und APIs. SQL oder Python sind ein Plus.

data.title: Junior Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
data.description:
Davon träumen wir:

Mehr als Recruiting. Die richtigen Menschen für die richtigen Aufgaben.
 
VielfaltMenü befindet sich in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung. Wir schärfen unsere Organisation, professionalisieren unsere Prozesse und richten uns noch konsequenter auf unsere Kund:innen, unsere Mitarbeiter:innen und nachhaltiges Wachstum aus.
Dazu gehört auch ein neues Verständnis von Recruiting.
Wir wollen Stellen nicht einfach besetzen. Wir wollen verstehen, welche Kompetenzen wir wirklich benötigen, wie wir sie erkennen und welche Menschen zu unserer Organisation und unseren Zielen passen.

Dafür suchen wir dich als Junior Talent Acquisition Partner:in

Du musst nicht bereits zehn Jahre Recruiting-Erfahrung mitbringen. 
Entscheidend sind für uns analytisches Denken, Neugier, ein ausgeprägter Qualitätsanspruch und die Fähigkeit, Menschen und Kompetenzen gut einzuschätzen.
  
Deine Aufgaben
Du begleitest Recruitingprozesse von der ersten Anforderungsanalyse bis zum unterschriebenen Arbeitsvertrag und entwickelst gemeinsam mit People & Culture unsere Recruitingstandards weiter.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Führungskräften und der Geschäftsführung zusammen.
Talent Acquisition & Beratung
Du führst strukturierte Briefings mit Führungskräften und übersetzt Anforderungen in klare Kompetenz- und Kandidatenprofile.
Du berätst Führungskräfte bei der Auswahl geeigneter Kandidat:innen und sprichst auch dann eine klare Empfehlung aus, wenn die einfachste Lösung nicht die beste ist.
Interviews führst du eigenständig – vom operativen Recruiting bis hin zu Gesprächen auf Managementebene.
Kompetenzorientierte Auswahl
Wir wollen Auswahlentscheidungen stärker auf Kompetenzen und nachvollziehbare Kriterien stützen.
Du entwickelst strukturierte Interviewleitfäden, Bewertungsmatrizen und Auswahlstandards und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Entscheidungen vergleichbarer und belastbarer werden.
Bei diagnostischen Auswahlverfahren und Assessments begleitest du Konzeption, Durchführung und Auswertung.
Dein Anspruch dabei: weniger Bauchgefühl, mehr Qualität in der Entscheidung.
Candidate Experience & Kreativität
Professionelle Prozesse dürfen trotzdem persönlich sein.
Du entwickelst Ideen, wie wir Kandidat:innen besser erreichen und ihnen vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Einstellung eine überzeugende Candidate Experience bieten.
Dabei probierst du neue Recruitingwege aus, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns moderne Recruitingformate.
Vertragsmanagement & Prozesse
Du steuerst den Recruitingprozess zuverlässig bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
Du bereitest Vertragsangebote vor, koordinierst Abstimmungen und sorgst dafür, dass Vereinbarungen vollständig, korrekt und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.
Arbeitsrechtliche und datenschutzrechtliche Fragestellungen erkennst du und kannst sie gemeinsam mit People & Culture bzw. unserer juristischen Expertise einordnen.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, standardisiert und detailgenau – ohne dabei unnötige Bürokratie aufzubauen.
 
Was du mitbringst
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftspsychologie, Psychologie, Personalmanagement, Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Erste praktische Erfahrung im Recruiting, Talent Acquisition, HR oder in der Personalauswahl ist hilfreich – beispielsweise durch Werkstudententätigkeiten, Praktika oder deine erste berufliche Station.
Auch wenn du am Anfang deiner Karriere stehst, freuen wir uns ausdrücklich auf deine Bewerbung.
Wichtiger als die Anzahl deiner Berufsjahre ist für uns, wie du denkst und arbeitest.
Du hast Interesse an eignungsdiagnostischen und kompetenzorientierten Auswahlverfahren.
Du kannst Gespräche strukturieren, genau zuhören, kritisch nachfragen und deine Einschätzung anschließend nachvollziehbar begründen.
Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und keine Scheu davor, mit Führungskräften und Geschäftsführung auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren.
Juristische Fragestellungen – insbesondere rund um Arbeitsverträge und Arbeitsrecht – schrecken dich nicht ab. Idealerweise bringst du bereits entsprechende Grundkenntnisse mit.
Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig und hast gleichzeitig Freude daran, Dinge neu zu denken.
 

Was uns bei dir besonders wichtig ist
Kreativität. 
Du akzeptierst nicht automatisch, dass Recruiting so funktionieren muss, wie es schon immer funktioniert hat.
Struktur. 
Du glaubst an Standards, klare Prozesse und nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen.
Detailorientierung.  
Ein falsches Datum im Arbeitsvertrag ist für dich keine Kleinigkeit.
Urteilsvermögen.
Du möchtest verstehen, welche Kompetenzen jemand wirklich mitbringt – und nicht nur, wie gut sich jemand präsentieren kann.
Mut zur Empfehlung.
Von dir erwarten wir nicht nur Organisation. Wir wollen deine Einschätzung hören.
Neugier.
Du möchtest verstehen, wie unser Geschäft funktioniert und was unsere Führungskräfte und Teams erfolgreich macht.
 

Was dich bei VielfaltMenü erwartet
VielfaltMenü steht für „Mehr als gutes Essen.“
Wir versorgen täglich Menschen in Bildungseinrichtungen und entwickeln uns als Unternehmen kontinuierlich weiter. People & Culture soll dabei nicht nur verwalten, sondern die Entwicklung des Unternehmens aktiv unterstützen. Du bekommst deshalb die Möglichkeit, unser Recruiting nicht nur auszuführen, sondern mitzugestalten. Du arbeitest eng mit Führungskräften, dem People & Culture-Team sowie der Geschäftsführung zusammen und erhältst früh Verantwortung für eigene Recruitingprozesse. Gleichzeitig geben wir dir Raum, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
In deiner Rolle genießt du echten Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust moderne Qualitäts- sowie Prozessstrukturen aktiv mit auf und prägst die Standards eines führenden Unternehmens für Kita- und Schulverpflegung in Deutschland. Dabei profitierst du von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer Geschäftsführung, die Qualität strategisch fördert.
Neben einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einem zukunftssicheren Markt erwarten dich eine attraktive, transparente Vergütung sowie klare Entwicklungsperspektiven durch strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Weiterbildungen. Wir unterstützen deine Work-Life-Balance durch 30 Urlaubstage, geregelte Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten. Zudem erhältst du moderne Arbeitsmittel inklusive Diensthandy. Eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und ein engagiertes, kollegiales Team runden unser Angebot ab.
 

Klingt nach dir?
Dann interessiert uns nicht nur dein Lebenslauf.
Wir möchten wissen, wie du über Menschen, Kompetenzen und gute Personalauswahl denkst.
Bewirb dich bei uns und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns, wie Recruiting bei VielfaltMenü künftig funktioniert.
 
VielfaltMenü – Mehr als gutes Essen.

data.title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
data.description:
ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.


The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

  • Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.

  • Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

  • You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

  • You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.

  • You focus on building a great product.

  • You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

    • The interview process

data.title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x)
data.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.

At exmox, data is the compass that guides product, commercial, and financial decisions. We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact.

As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability.

What You'll Own:

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Support, Fraud, and LiveOps teams to bring clarity to ambiguous problems and support decisions with evidence.
  • Turn vague business questions, product or commercial, into structured hypotheses, experiments, and decision-ready analyses.
  • Use Claude and Databricks as core tools for analysis and automation, not just for dashboarding, including working with high frequency data updating every few minutes rather than static daily aggregates.
  • Track and analyze performance across product, campaign, revenue, and profitability dimensions, adapting focus to wherever decision support is most needed.
  • Build dashboards and self-service tools that let teams monitor performance without repeated ad hoc requests.
  • Identify gaps in tracking and data quality early, and help improve instrumentation across domains.
  • Absorb new business context quickly when redeployed to a different stakeholder team, contributing decision-ready work within weeks.
  • Share your thinking openly, from quick prototypes to final recommendations, to help the team learn faster.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Product, commercial, and financial decisions are driven by evidence: Your work directly shapes prioritization, budget allocation, and go/no go calls across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Risks and opportunities are identified early: Margin erosion, engagement drops, and high-LTV pockets are surfaced before they become obvious.
  • You operate across domains without losing time: When moving from one business question to another, you ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks, not months.
  • You drive the shift toward AI-heavy analytics: You use Claude to move faster and push the team's tooling forward rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

What You Bring

  • Experienced: 5+ years of experience in product, business, or behavioral analytics, ideally spanning more than one domain (product, marketing, finance, or commercial operations); B2C, mobile gaming, or AdTech experience is a plus.
  • AI Fluency: Genuine hands-on experience working with AI tools like Claude as part of your daily workflow, not just occasional use.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong Databricks and/or Spark experience with several years of real, hands on exposure; strong SQL and Python skills for analysis, automation, and modeling; BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) for dashboarding.
  • Analytical and Performance-Driven Mindset: Comfortable framing ambiguous questions into structured hypotheses and evaluating experiments (A/B tests, incrementality).
  • Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication skills, able to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders through structured, data-driven argumentation.
  • Independent and solution-oriented mindset: Comfortable operating in fast-paced, international environments.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany, working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Benefits

💡 Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum – deine Ideen zählen.

data.title: Personalreferent (m/w/d) Schwerpunkt Personaladministration & Payroll
data.description:
Über Simba Computer Systeme GmbH

Gestalte heute mit uns, was morgen zählt – mit Teamgeist, einem guten Gespür für Menschen und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam unsere Personalarbeit weiterzuentwickeln. Bei Simba findest du ein Umfeld, das auf klare Prozesse, echtes Miteinander und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung setzt – fachlich und menschlich.

Als Personalreferent (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres HR-Teams und begleitest gemeinsam mit uns unsere Mitarbeiter & Mitarbeiterinnen durch den Arbeitsalltag. Dabei übernimmst du eigene Aufgabenbereiche, sorgst für eine zuverlässige Personaladministration und bringst deine Erfahrung in der Entgeltabrechnung ein. Gleichzeitig befinden wir uns mitten in der Weiterentwicklung unserer HR-Prozesse und der Implementierung von REXX – hier kannst du aktiv mitgestalten und deine Ideen einbringen.

Auf dich wartet eine noch frische HR-Abteilung mit vielseitigen Themen, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Raum, eigene Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Klingt das nach dir? Dann bewirb dich beim #TeamSimba und lass uns zusammen mehr erreichen!

WAS SIND DEINE AUFGABEN?

  • Personaladministration: du übernimmst eigenständig administrative HR-Aufgaben vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Pflege unserer Personalstammdaten und -unterlagen

  • Personalbetreuung: gemeinsam im Team bist du Ansprechpartner für unsere Mitarbeiter & Mitarbeiterinnen bei personalrelevanten Fragestellungen

  • HR-Prozesse: du wirkst bei der Gestaltung neuer und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Personalprozesse mit und bringst dabei deine Erfahrungen und Ideen ein

  • Payroll: du betreust unsere monatliche Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung und kümmerst dich zuverlässig um alle dazugehörigen abrechnungsrelevanten Themen

  • REXX: du unterstützt aktiv bei der Implementierung unseres neuen HR-Systems und wirkst dabei mit, unsere Prozesse sinnvoll und praxisnah im System abzubilden

  • Zusammenarbeit: du arbeitest eng mit unseren Abteilungen und Führungskräften zusammen und sorgst gemeinsam im Team für verlässliche und praktikable Lösungen

WAS BRINGST DU MIT?

  • Erfahrung: mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Personalbereich sowie praktische Erfahrung in der Personaladministration und Personalbetreuung

  • Payroll: fundierte Kenntnisse in der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung sowie im Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht

  • Gerne gesehen: Erfahrung mit REXX oder einem vergleichbaren HR-System, belastbare Kenntnisse in der Abrechnung bspw. mit SBS, sowie Freude daran, digitale HR-Prozesse mitzugestalten

  • Persönlichkeit: kommunikativ, verbindlich und zuverlässig sowie eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise

  • Ausbildung: abgeschlossenes Studium oder Berufsausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Personal, BWL oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Sprachkenntnisse: verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse Deine Benefits

WAS BIETEN WIR DIR?

  • Onboarding: fundierte und professionelle Einarbeitung, sowie enge Begleitung durch einen Mentor

  • Ausstattung: modern und ergonomisch ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, hochwertige IT-Ausstattung

  • Work-Life-Balance: flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Zeiterfassung und Gleitzeitkonto, Option auf mobiles Arbeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Gehaltspaket: attraktives und leistungsgerechtes Gehalt, inkl. großzügigem Weihnachtsgeld

  • Mitarbeiterangebote: Kostenlose Getränke und leckeren Kaffee, Corporate Benefit Programm, Team-Events, Zahnzusatzversicherung, sowie individuelle Angebote in unseren Niederlassungen (Eis-Flatrate im Sommer, Kanu-Tour oder Whiskey Tasting)

  • Weiterentwicklung: stetige Weiterentwicklung und gezielte Förderung der persönlichen – und fachlichen Skills

  • Unternehmenskultur: offene Feedbackkultur, flache Hierarchien, kollegiale Du-Kultur, ein wertschätzender Umgang und die Möglichkeit dich aktiv mit deinen Ideen bei uns einzubringen

NOCH FRAGEN?

In den ersten Wochen wirst du intensiv in unsere internen Abläufe und die Besonderheiten Bei Rückfragen zur Position oder unserem Bewerbungsprozess stehen wir dir gerne zur Verfügung.

data.title: Technical Sales (m/w/d)
data.description:
Über uns

Wir sind Hoffmann AM (ehemals Jellypipe) – ein aufstrebendes Technologieunternehmen, das mit der starken Unterstützung der Hoffmann Group seinen Wachstumskurs in Europa vorantreibt. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der industriellen additiven Fertigung (3D-Druck).

Unsere Mission ist es, 3D-Druck für Unternehmen jeder Größe und Branche einfach und zugänglich zu machen. Dafür kombinieren wir innovative digitale Lösungen mit einem starken internationalen Produktionsnetzwerk und umfassender technischer Expertise.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine technisch versierte, engagierte Persönlichkeit, die mit Begeisterung, Eigeninitiative und Freude am Kundenkontakt zum weiteren Wachstum unseres Unternehmens beiträgt.

Als Technical Sales (m/w/d) bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, dem Vertrieb und unseren internationalen Produktionspartnern. Du begleitest spannende Projekte von der technischen Anfrage über die Kalkulation bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und hilfst unseren Kunden, die Möglichkeiten des industriellen 3D-Drucks optimal zu nutzen.

Aufgaben

  • Technische Kundenberatung: Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Auswahl geeigneter 3D-Druckverfahren, Materialien und Fertigungslösungen und bewertest die technische und wirtschaftliche Machbarkeit ihrer Projekte.
  • Angebotsbearbeitung und Kalkulation: Du analysierst Kundenanfragen, technische Zeichnungen und 3D-Modelle, erstellst individuelle Angebote und entwickelst wirtschaftlich attraktive Lösungen.
  • Projektbetreuung: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte von der ersten Anfrage über die technische Abstimmung und Angebotserstellung bis zur erfolgreichen Auftragsabwicklung.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Produktionspartnern: Du koordinierst technische Fragestellungen mit unseren internationalen Fertigungspartnern und stellst sicher, dass Kundenanforderungen optimal umgesetzt werden.
  • Unterstützung des Vertriebs: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Sales-Team und dem Außendienst der Hoffmann Group zusammen und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung neuer Kundenprojekte und industrieller Anwendungen.
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Plattform: Du bringst dein technisches Know-how und deine Praxiserfahrung in die kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Automatisierung unserer digitalen Angebots- und Bestellplattform ein.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Abläufe und Strukturen, um Effizienz, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit kontinuierlich zu steigern.
  • Kundenbesuche und Veranstaltungen: Bei Bedarf begleitest du Kundentermine und repräsentierst Hoffmann AM auf Fachmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen.

Qualifikationen

Technische Ausbildung und Erfahrung

  • Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, beispielsweise als Konstrukteur, Polymechaniker, Technischer Produktdesigner oder in einem vergleichbaren technischen Beruf. Alternativ ein technisches Studium.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit technischen Zeichnungen, 3D-CAD-Modellen und technischen Spezifikationen.
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich der additiven Fertigung (3D-Druck), insbesondere zu Technologien, Materialien und industriellen Anwendungen, sind von Vorteil.
  • Gutes technisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, Kundenanforderungen in wirtschaftlich und technisch geeignete Fertigungslösungen zu übersetzen.

Persönliche Fähigkeiten

  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt sowie Interesse an technischen und kommerziellen Fragestellungen.

data.title: Senior Digital IC Design Engineer
data.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company.

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).


Functions of the Role

This senior position operates at the critical intersection of sub-Kelvin sub-system electronics and quantum processor architectures, directly addressing the interconnect bottleneck in scalable quantum computing systems. The role spans the full digital IC design cycle—including initial microarchitecture specification, RTL development, Verilog-AMS co-simulation, physical implementation (PnR/CTS), low-power synthesis, static timing analysis (STA), and full tape-out signoff. The ultimate objective is the realization of ultra-low-power, high-density cryogenic control ICs tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computing scale-out.


  • Position Title:  Senior Digital Designer (Front-End & Back-End)

  • Domain Focus:  Ultra-Low-Power Cryogenic CMOS (Cryo-CMOS) Digital Control Sub-circuits

  • Design Scope:  Full Lifecycle (RTL Development, AMS Co-Simulation, Physical Implementation, Low-Power Synthesis, and Tape-Out Signoff)

  • Core Chip Architecture Target: Cryogenic digital logic blocks operating at sub-Kelvin regimes (<4.2 K), 


Experience - Essentials

  • Education: Master's degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.

  • Chip Design Experience: 5+ years of hands-on digital and mixed-signal IC design, demonstrating successful completion of at least 2 tape-outs on advanced semiconductor nodes 

  • Hardware Coding: Proficiency in Verilog and SystemVerilog for synthesizable RTL development and Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog-Real-Math for mixed-signal co-simulation and testbench environments.

  • Design Tools: Proven proficiency with industry-standard EDA toolchains (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus/Xcelium, Synopsys Design Compiler) for mixed-signal simulation, synthesis, and verification.

  • Physical Layout: Demonstrated capability in transforming RTL into GDSII/OASIS physical layouts, floorplanning, power grid synthesis, clock tree synthesis (CTS), multi-corner multi-mode static timing analysis (MCMM STA), and physical signoff (DRC/LVS/ERC).

  • Communication & Logic Design: Experience architecting high-speed serial interconnect protocols (e.g., custom SPI, AXI, SerDes) and complex finite-state machine (FSM) control logic.

  • Low Power & Thermal Management: Deep expertise in low-power dissipation techniques (clock gating, power gating, dynamic voltage scaling) within stringent thermal lift budgets of cryogenic cooling systems.


Experience - Desirable

  • Cryogenic CMOS Experience: Hands-on experience designing, modeling, or characterizing CMOS circuits at sub-4.2 K temperatures and understanding cryo-specific transistor behavior.
  • Mixed-Signal & AMS Interfaces: Direct integration of digital logic with precision analog/RF front-ends (ADCs, DACs, LNAs, AWGs) for qubit control and readout.
  • Quantum Architecture Awareness: Familiarity with quantum control interfaces, pulse generation, error correction, or cryogenic spin qubit electronics
  • Low-Power Verification & UPF/CPF: Proficiency in power-aware simulation using IEEE 1801 UPF/CPF, formal LEC, and power signoff tools (Voltus, PrimePower).
  • Advanced Process Nodes: Experience with sub-28nm nodes, with a strong preference for FD-SOI or FinFET technologies.
  • EDA Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills (TCL, Python) to automate synthesis, physical design, and verification flows.
  • DFT & Silicon Bring-Up: Practical knowledge of DFT insertion (Scan, MBIST) and post-silicon laboratory bring-up, testing, and debug.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team
  • Competitive salary and share options scheme
  • Contributory pension scheme
  • Group private medical insurance scheme
  • Choose your own laptop/kit
  • Life Assurance
  • Cycle-to-work Scheme
  • Flexible working
  • Central London location

data.title: Project Manager
data.description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. data.title: Director of Deployment
data.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role

We're looking for a Director of Deployment to lead our Solutions team, the engineers who get our product live in industrial customers' plants, and to make every deployment faster, better and more reliable than the last.

You'll be accountable for every deployment we run, and be the senior escalation route, for our team and our customers, when something gets stuck.

This is a new role, and a leadership role, but a hands-on one. You'll coach our solutions engineers and leaders as they own deployments and customer relationships themselves, and step in yourself when a plant needs it. You'll work with Product, Machine Learning and Engineering to decide what goes back into the core product, so every plant is faster than the last.

What will this role achieve?

The goal: Take Gigaton from 9 plants live to 50 by the end of 2027, with every new plant going from signed contract to the end of evaluation in 8 weeks.

Outcome – 50 plants live. You've taken us from 9 plants to 50 by 31 December 2027, across our customers worldwide. You've planned how many engineers we need and which teams new joiners go into, tracked the health of the whole portfolio every week, and stepped in early when a deployment started to drift.

Outcome – 8 weeks from contract to results. Today a plant takes about six months to reach evaluation. You've cut that to 8 weeks end to end, and published the numbers that prove it. You've done it by turning repeated human work and customer-specific work into product, built with Product and Engineering. Each plant now needs half the people it did when you joined.

Outcome – a grip on results. Before we start, every plant has agreed with us what success looks like and whose data counts. You've balanced the need to hit our timelines with the need to pass evaluations, pausing a plant that isn't ready rather than letting it fail, so every evaluation has passed first time. When something has gone wrong, you've found the root cause fast and fixed it, so we only make each mistake once.

Outcome – a team of superstars that keeps growing. You've designed the team that delivers 50 plants and grown it to the size your design needs, hiring people who raise our bar. You've coached it actively: your leaders run high-performing teams, every engineer is autonomous, happy and smashing it for our customers, and everyone in Solutions can name what they've got better at because of you. We haven't lost anyone we wanted to keep.

Outcome – customers who trust us at every level. Every plant has a clear owner, and an escalation route that solves problems before they reach our exec team. You've built a clean handover from Sales and a voice for Deployment in which plants we take on.

Outcome – post-sales solved. With our sales leader, you've set up how we run every plant after evaluation, and it works, with clear responsibilities mapped out. Model upkeep, support and retraining are handled. Expansion contracts and upsells run through the same model: each one has a clear owner, and we spot opportunities before the customer raises them.

What a great fit looks like

  • You have deployed early AI product into business customers, hands-on and alongside engineers. You worked out what would create value and decided what was worth building. Not onboarding customers onto a product that was already finished.

  • You have turned bespoke work into repeatable product. You decided which customer-specific features and fixes belonged in the core product, and you can show the numbers: deployments that got faster, with fewer people, while volume grew.

  • You have earned the trust of customer leaders, from site head up to executive level, been their escalation point and unblocked hard problems. You're credible because you've built and shipped.

  • You have grown a delivery team and made the decisions that came with it, including hiring and performance management. You've designed the team's structure as it grew.

  • You're a coach who was recently a quarterback. You can still step in, but you know you'll have more impact by building a team that doesn't need you to.

  • You agree what success means with a customer before you start, and you prove it with numbers.

  • You notice early signs of trouble and raise them with urgency, and you use judgement to tell what needs action and what doesn't.

  • You're happy to travel to our plants worldwide, about a quarter of the time and more in your first few months: to build relationships with customer leaders, coach your team on site and learn how our plants run.

You'll excel if

  • You have managed managers, or grown an engineer into a team lead.

  • You have worked in a forward-deployed or deployment strategist model, where small teams embed with customers.

  • You have set up post-sales or account management for a B2B product.

  • You have deployed software into physical operations: plants, factories, utilities, energy assets or similar.

  • You care about decarbonising energy intensive industries.

Details

  • Reports to: Noah Miller, COO

  • Team: our Solutions team of solutions engineers and two team leads, which you'll lead and grow

  • Location: London, at least 2 days a week in the office, with about 25% travel to customer plants

  • Visa sponsorship: available if required

💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from different countries, cultures and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process - subject to change

We aim to go from first call to offer in three weeks.

  1. First call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

  2. Interview with Noah, our COO, walking through your career (60 minutes)

  3. Work sample day. We share real data from one of our plants. You spend 30 minutes with two of our team leads, then present how you'd run the deployment and how you'd shape the team for 50 plants. Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s Robot Software group turns new vehicle programs into stable, reliable robot systems. The Platform Integration team works at the boundary between onboard software and vehicle hardware, bringing up new platforms while building reusable components and frameworks that make every future integration faster and more predictable.

As a Software Engineer on the Platform Integration team, you’ll combine hands-on vehicle and bench work with production software development. Your work will directly enable safe, scalable deployment across multiple vehicle programs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Support software bring-up on benches, HiL systems, and vehicles, including work at international test locations.

  • Develop and maintain vehicle-facing software components and shared frameworks.

  • Diagnose integration issues across software and hardware boundaries and drive them through resolution.

  • Identify architectural improvements that reduce bespoke work and improve reuse.

  • Build diagnostics, tooling, and metrics for robot-software reliability and performance.

  • Produce clear documentation and runbooks for long-term supportability.

  • Collaborate with hardware, safety, controls, calibration, and reliability teams.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • New vehicle-program bring-up across embedded compute, sensors, networks, and software services.

  • Linux-based robotic and automotive systems with multi-process and distributed architectures.

  • ROS2 or similar middleware, node development, message interfaces, and system integration.

  • Sensor calibration, synchronisation, data validation, and system-level debugging.

  • Automotive-grade compute platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE and Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride.

  • Vehicle communication systems including CAN and Automotive Ethernet.

  • Shared abstractions and frameworks that improve reliability across programs.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You have strong software-development experience in C++, Python, or Rust.

  • You have delivered production-quality software on Linux-based robotic, embedded, or automotive platforms.

  • You understand ROS2 or similar robotics middleware and distributed-system integration.

  • You have hands-on experience integrating software with vehicle or embedded hardware.

  • You can diagnose complex problems using logs, telemetry, on-target tests, and systematic experimentation.

data.title: Junior Market Data Analyst – Chartering
data.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 700 experts from 35+ countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.


Your future position

Join Kpler’s Chartering team as a Junior Market Data Analyst – Chartering and play a key role in ensuring the quality and accuracy of the data that powers our Chartering products.

Kpler’s Chartering products rely on accurate vessel, ownership and market data to help charterers, shipowners and brokers make informed commercial decisions. In this role, you will work hands-on with the datasets behind these products, investigating inconsistencies, validating information and helping improve data quality at scale.

Your work will span a range of chartering datasets, from vessel ownership and characteristics to fixtures, cargo orders, vessel positions and shipping zones. You will use SQL and Python to extract, transform and analyse data, build validation checks and investigate potential issues. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys getting into the detail of data, asking why something doesn't look right and finding ways to identify and solve problems systematically. You will work closely with Product, Data, Research, Engineering and AI/ML teams, turning individual data issues into broader improvements across Kpler's datasets and products.


Your mission is to:
  • Monitor, validate and improve the quality of key datasets supporting Kpler's Chartering products.
  • Investigate data gaps, inconsistencies and customer-reported issues, using data analysis to understand their root causes and drive them through to resolution.
  • Curate and validate vessel ownership, commercial management, operator information and relevant vessel characteristics.
  • Review and benchmark AI-parsed fixtures, identifying recurring extraction errors and building validation approaches to measure and improve parsing quality.
  • Use SQL to query large datasets, including cargo and AIS data, to investigate potential issues and identify incorrect or inconsistent information at scale.
  • Use Python notebooks to extract, transform and analyse data and develop validation scripts and repeatable quality checks.
  • Maintain and improve Kpler's chartering-specific shipping zones and geographical mappings, using tools such as QGIS.
  • Work with Product, Data, Research, Engineering and AI/ML teams to provide structured feedback and help improve the quality of underlying datasets and extraction processes.
  • Translate individual data-quality issues into systematic improvements where appropriate, identifying patterns rather than only correcting individual records.
  • Contribute to the development of new analytical views and algorithms as the Chartering product evolves, including areas such as CPP/DPP and projected vessels.
  • Help establish and track data-quality metrics, benchmarks and processes as Chartering datasets expand.

    • Experience & Background:
  • 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, market research, maritime/shipping, commodities or a related analytical role.
  • Proven hands-on experience with SQL and confidence writing queries to analyse and investigate large datasets.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Python, including working in notebooks and using Python for data analysis, transformation or validation.
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and an ability to identify patterns and inconsistencies in data.
  • Comfortable working with large datasets and extracting and transforming data to investigate specific questions
    • Desirable:
  • Understanding of shipping, chartering or commodity markets.
  • Familiarity with tanker and/or dry-bulk vessel segments.
  • Understanding of concepts such as fixtures, vessel positions, cargo orders, vessel ownership and shipping geography.
  • Experience working with AI/LLM-extracted or other machine-generated datasets.
  • Experience with maritime data providers, brokers, shipowners, charterers or commodity trading companies.

    • You are naturally curious and want to understand why data is wrong, not just identify that it is wrong.

About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements.

In this role, you will:

  • Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.

  • Provide end-to-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.

  • Become a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and systems, serving as a critical escalation point and a technical backstop for our most strategic customers.

  • Own the customer-specific response to high-impact incidents. You’ll assess severity and business impact, initiate the appropriate response path, coordinate cross-functional responders, maintain clear ownership, and ensure issues move through mitigation, resolution, and post-incident follow-through.

  • Communicate clearly and proactively during periods of uncertainty, providing accurate updates to customer technical teams, business stakeholders, executives, and internal partners.

  • Develop a detailed understanding of each customer’s architecture, integrations, dependencies, critical workloads, and operational constraints. You’ll document this context and make it accessible to Support, Product, and Engineering teams.

  • Lead or contribute to incident reviews and postmortems, identify opportunities to prevent recurrence, and track corrective actions through closure.

  • Translate recurring customer pain into clear, evidence-backed feedback for Product and Engineering, with a particular focus on improving the reliability and performance of existing products, integrations, and deployments.

  • Turn what you learn from customer investigations into scalable improvements, including troubleshooting guides, monitoring, internal tooling, support workflows, and AI-powered automation.

  • Help shape the operating model, technical standards, and tooling for Premium Support as the function grows globally.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have significant experience in Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or another role involving hands-on diagnosis of complex production issues.

  • Are comfortable working with logs, metrics, traces, API requests, authentication flows, and customer-provided code or configurations to understand system behavior and test hypotheses.

data.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. OpenAI for Government (OAI4G) helps public-sector institutions understand, adopt, and deploy highly capable AI products in support of their missions. The team brings together Sales, Solutions, Partnerships, Technical Success, Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, and other cross-functional partners to help governments use AI responsibly and effectively.

As part of OAI4G’s International Public Sector team, you will help public institutions in the UK, Middle East (ME) and Latin America (LATAM) translate frontier AI into secure, compliant, mission-aligned outcomes. We work across varied procurement, regulatory, security, sovereignty, and commercial environments, while maintaining a consistent commitment to safety, reliability, and public benefit.

About the role

We are seeking a Global Account Director (GAD) to lead OpenAI’s public-sector work across the UK, ME and LATAM. You will build trusted relationships with government leaders, develop and execute account strategies, create and close complex opportunities, and help customers move from initial interest to successful adoption.

This is a full-cycle, highly cross-functional sales role that combines technical understanding, strategic vision, partnership management, and value-driven execution. You will work with senior government, operational, technical, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders to identify high-impact AI use cases and translate them into credible commercial and deployment pathways across the OpenAI Platform API and Codex and ChatGPT Enterprise.

You will also be an accountable customer leader after signature, working alongside specialist delivery and technical teams to keep customer outcomes, milestones, adoption, risks, and executive alignment on track. The role requires excellent judgement, executive presence, local fluency, and the ability to move between strategy, discovery, capture, procurement, delivery governance, and relationship management without day-to-day direction.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will

  • Own a focused portfolio of UK, ME and LATAM public-sector accounts.

  • Build and execute comprehensive account plans that map mission priorities, stakeholders, procurement paths, partners, use cases, risks, and long-term expansion opportunities.

  • Drive complex opportunities through the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation, discovery, qualification, capture, and commercial strategy through negotiation, closure, adoption, and expansion.

  • Lead public-sector customers through their AI adoption journey, helping them identify responsible, high-impact use cases and connect mission outcomes to OpenAI’s capabilities and limitations.

  • Translate between government leaders, end users, technical teams, policy and security stakeholders, and internal product and engineering partners, clearly communicating requirements, progress, risks, and dependencies.

  • Serve as the accountable customer lead for engagements tied to clear outcomes, customer milestones, adoption measures, and commercial commitments, coordinating closely with technical specialists.

  • Navigate public-sector procurement, tendering, security, data-residency, compliance, and sovereignty requirements, bringing Legal, Security, Policy, Global Affairs, Finance, and other partners into opportunities early.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior government executives and decision-makers, while staying close to operational users and technical stakeholders whose workflows determine successful adoption.

  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, account records, customer follow-up, and executive reporting, with disciplined follow-through across markets and time zones.

  • Monitor the government, technology, procurement, partner, and competitive landscape across UK, ME and LATAM markets, surfacing insights that inform product roadmaps and go-to-market strategy.

  • Represent OpenAI at government, partner, and industry forums, strengthening networks and identifying opportunities that advance responsible public-sector adoption of AI.


We’re seeking someone with experience including

  • 10+ years in government, diplomacy, national security, international development, multilateral institutions, public-sector technology sales, business development, consulting, transformation, systems integration, or a closely related field, with meaningful ownership of complex customer outcomes.

  • Direct experience in government, diplomacy, national security, foreign affairs, or international organisations, or very significant experience working with those customers in sensitive, regulated, or high-consequence environments.

  • Executive presence with senior diplomats, ministers, multilateral executives, government leaders, and decision-makers, alongside credibility with technical, operational, procurement, policy, and security stakeholders.

  • Sound understanding of multilateral and public-sector procurement, funding, contracting, security, privacy, data-residency, sovereignty, and compliance requirements across more than one ME or LATAM market.

  • Ability to orchestrate regional and international partners, including system integrators, resellers, cloud providers, development institutions, advisory partners, and delivery partners.

  • Enough AI and enterprise-technology fluency to explain OpenAI’s products, capabilities, limitations, and responsible-use trade-offs clearly to diplomatic, multilateral, and government audiences, and to engage the right specialists early.

  • High ownership, exceptional written and verbal communication, diplomatic judgement under ambiguity, strong capacity management across regions and time zones, and willingness to travel across ME and LATAM, and internationally as needed.

Nice to have

  • Deep relationships across international organisations, regional bodies, development institutions, foreign affairs, defence, national security, or other sensitive public-sector communities.

  • Experience developing opportunities across more than one ME or LATAM market, ideally with exposure to international organisations or regional bodies.

  • Experience with AI/ML, cloud, data platforms, cybersecurity, API-based products, public-sector digital transformation, or regulated cross-border technology deployments.
